class.name: LocalizationCatalogList
class.brief_description: A list of localization catalog files with priorities.

method.name: add_entry
method.description: Appends an entry with [param path] (a file, or a file name with wildcards) and [param priority].

method.name: get_catalog_paths
method.description: Returns the catalog files of all entries, sorted by priority (lowest first; entries with the same priority keep their order). A path with wildcards expands to the matching files of its folder in alphabetical order, only files with a catalog extension ([code]lcat[/code], [code]csv[/code], [code]json[/code], [code]yaml[/code], [code]yml[/code], [code]toml[/code], [code]ini[/code], [code]xml[/code]); a missing folder gives no files. Paths without wildcards are returned as they are, even if the file does not exist.

method.name: get_entry_path
method.description: Returns the path of the entry at [param index].

method.name: get_entry_priority
method.description: Returns the priority of the entry at [param index].

method.name: set_entry_path
method.description: Sets the path of the entry at [param index].

method.name: set_entry_priority
method.description: Sets the priority of the entry at [param index]. Higher priorities come later and win over lower ones.

members.member: The number of entries. Raising it appends empty entries.
